# Snapforge Lab

> Snapforge Lab is an independent Replit Solution Partner. We review, fix and deploy Replit and Replit Agent apps, and build custom business apps (dashboards, CRMs, client portals, AI assistants) on Replit at fixed prices, for clients worldwide.

## Services
- [Ship-Ready Review](https://snapforgelab.com/replit-app-to-production/): $199 production-readiness audit of a Replit Agent app, delivered in 48 hours, full refund if fewer than 3 real issues are found.
- [Ship-It Sprint](https://snapforgelab.com/replit-app-to-production/): $990 fixed price to fix a Replit app and deploy it to production in 5 days (review fee credited).
- [Starter Build](https://snapforgelab.com/#pricing): custom business app on Replit, $2,500 fixed ($1,500 for founding clients), live in about 7 days.
- [Care](https://snapforgelab.com/#pricing): $249/month hosting, monitoring and improvements.
- [Hire a Replit developer](https://snapforgelab.com/hire-replit-developer/)

## Free tools
- [Replit Readiness Score](https://snapforgelab.com/tools/replit-readiness-score/): 2-minute self-assessment that scores whether a Replit app is ready for real users.

## Guides
- [Is Replit production-ready? An honest answer for business apps](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/is-replit-production-ready/): Can you run a real business app on Replit? What the platform handles well, where AI-built apps usually fall short, which apps are a good fit, and a 10-point test before you launch.
- [Replit Agent security checklist: 15 checks before you launch](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-agent-security-checklist/): The 15 security checks we run on every Replit Agent app before launch: secrets, authorization, input validation, databases, dependencies, costs and deployment. With how to test and fix each one.
- [How to deploy a Replit app to production, step by step](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/deploy-replit-app-to-production/): A practical launch runbook for Replit apps: pick the right deployment type, set production secrets, prepare the database, connect a custom domain, add monitoring and plan rollbacks.
- [Replit Autoscale vs Reserved VM vs Static vs Scheduled: which deployment should you choose?](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-deployment-types/): A plain-English comparison of Replit's deployment types: how Autoscale, Reserved VM, Static and Scheduled deployments work, when to use each, cold starts, background jobs and cost trade-offs.
- [Replit Agent keeps breaking your app? How to stop the fix loop](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-agent-keeps-breaking-app/): Why Replit Agent gets stuck fixing one bug and breaking another, how to roll back safely with checkpoints, and a prompting workflow that stops the loop and your credit bill from spiraling.
- [Replit development vs production database: how it works, and how not to lose data](https://snapforgelab.com/guides/replit-production-database/): How Replit separates development and production databases, what Agent can and can't touch, how schema changes reach production, and the backup and migration habits that keep customer data safe.
